responsibility: Generates the NLL liveness and Polonius kill/control-flow facts that are derived directly from MIR traversal. It visits MIR types, regions, arguments, statements, and terminators to mark free regions as live at each program location, emits CFG edges for Polonius’s point-based model, and records which existing loans are killed when locals go dead, assignments overwrite places, or call destinations are written, using the borrow set and place-conflict logic to make those kill facts precise.
